title: Patch: Stinkscape+ Balance Changes I
notes: Issue #3951, the designer's first Stinkyscape+ balance pass. Numbers: Legacy: Snom Bunny Mind Control sets the stolen Unit to 2/2; Jlockeed's Yamato Cannon (1), embiggen (2), 3/1; Abandoned Spice Tower 5 Spices; GIGA-ify (2); Jlarna (3); Fortify +5 Health (Radiant +10); Multiplicative Reconstructor (2); Mender (0); Cloaking Module (1); Thorium Reactor 4 mana; A Glimpse into the Endless Sea 8 turns; Last Hurrah discards 4; Endless Expedition's card (2); Wardrum (2) 4/4; Organic Produce's Radiant face 3 Fruits; Axnit, Narcor and Red Narcor sell for about 10%, 15% and 20% fewer Credits (4-14, 10-21, 16-32); the ten Terminus Starships hold 5 or 6 mana of Starship Pieces, five of each. Keywords: the four Walls trade Can't Defend for Taunt; Double Header and Ivory Tower gain Indestructible and Tradable; Phase Fabric also gives Divine Shield. Text: Scorch is 1/5, attacks once and its damage Burns 5 (Radiant 2/10, Burns 10, no Cloaked); Level Up! makes a Unit that destroyed an enemy Unit attacking Radiant (Radiant: any surviving attacker; R3951000, the engine's destroyedEnemy fact); Temporal Rift gains 1 more mana on both faces; Job Application hears back in 1 to 4 turns (R1865001's tables re-weighted); Organic Produce's base face Fruit costs (0); Tatches the Totem is summoned from the hand too; Unstable Clone Machine gains Activate: draw 1; A Glimpse into the Endless Sea's Radiant face gives 5 Armor; Second Wind is Indestructible, discards the hand then exiles the deck (Radiant: discards it, the engine's discard_library, R3951001), and lends Flashback as Sanctum does; Circadian Halfcycler summons 1 or 2 Interceptors, 2 a third of the time (R3951002); Phase Weaver already reads "End of turn" since #3946. The Marketplace marks every rolled card up to 108% (MARKETPLACE_MARKUP_PERCENT, R3951003), and the AI weighs Feng Shui's elements across turns (R3951100). Every changed script keeps its v0.6.2b script in KEPT_SCRIPTS (R767000). Wardrum, Tatches the Totem, Scorch, Phase Fabric, Thorium Reactor, Phase Weaver, Endless Expedition and Multiplicative Reconstructor are claimed by the pending card-text fragment (#3946), so their changes here ship with that patch (one card ships in one patch).

player.title: Stinkscape+ Balance Changes I
balance: Legacy: Snom Bunny Mind Control sets the stolen Unit to 2/2, down from 4/4.
The Marketplace's cards cost 8% more.
Axnit sells for 4–14 Credits (Radiant 8–28), down from 5–15 (Radiant 10–30).
Narcor sells for 10–21 Credits (Radiant 20–42), down from 12–25 (Radiant 24–50).
Red Narcor sells for 16–32 Credits (Radiant 32–64), down from 20–40 (Radiant 40–80).
The ten Terminus Starships each hold 5 or 6 mana of Starship Pieces, down from 5 to 12 (The Last Voyage, The Far Vagabond).
Jlockeed's Yamato Cannon costs (1), embiggened (2), and is 3/1 (Radiant 6/2), from (2), embiggened (3), and 4/1 (Radiant 8/2).
Abandoned Spice Tower adds 5 Spices, up from 3.
GIGA-ify costs (2), down from (3).
Jlarna costs (3), down from (4).
Fortify gives +5 Health (Radiant +10), up from +3 (Radiant +6).
Job Application hears back in 1 to 4 turns, down from 2 to 6.
Multiplicative Reconstructor costs (2), down from (3).
Mender costs (0), down from (1).
Cloaking Module costs (1), down from (2).
Thorium Reactor gains 4 mana, up from 3.
A Glimpse into the Endless Sea counts down 8 turns, down from 10.
Last Hurrah discards 4 cards, down from 6.
Endless Expedition's Terminus card costs (2), down from (3).
Wardrum costs (2) and is 4/4 (Radiant 8/8), from (3) and 5/5 (Radiant 10/10).
Organic Produce's Radiant face adds 3 Fruits, up from 2.
changes: Scorch is 1/5 (Radiant 2/10) and attacks once a turn, and its hits Burn 5 (Radiant 10); its Radiant face loses Cloaked.
Level Up!: after one of your Units attacks, if it destroyed an enemy Unit, it becomes Radiant. Radiant: every Unit of yours that attacks and survives becomes Radiant.
Thorium Wall, Surge Wall, Phase Wall and Plastanium Wall lose Can't Defend and gain Taunt.
Temporal Rift gains 1 more mana the turn you play it: 1 (Radiant 3).
Double Header gains Indestructible and Tradable.
Ivory Tower gains Indestructible and Tradable.
Organic Produce's base face Fruit costs (0) too.
Tatches the Totem is summoned from your hand as well as your deck.
Unstable Clone Machine gains Activate: Draw 1.
Phase Fabric also gives Divine Shield.
A Glimpse into the Endless Sea's Radiant face also gives your hero 5 Armor.
Second Wind is Indestructible. Cry: discard your hand and exile your deck (Radiant: discard your hand and your deck). Aura: every card in your deck and graveyard has Flashback.
Circadian Halfcycler summons 1 or 2 Drone Interceptors, 2 a third of the time.
